basic_profile.bio: A 45-year-old sound engineer from Portland, Oregon, ToneSmith78 has been passionate about music and gear since his teenage years. Known for his deep dives into guitar pedal setups and soundscaping, he has a knack for creating unique sound experiences. While he loves experimenting with new gear, he dislikes overly commercialized music. ToneSmith78 is a night owl, often online from late evening to early morning. Currently single, he spends his weekends jamming with friends or attending local gigs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ToneSmith78 holds a degree in Audio Engineering and has over 20 years of experience working in various recording studios. He is self-taught in digital sound processing and has contributed to several indie music projects. His expertise is further honed by continuous experimentation with guitar setups and recording techniques.
